name: Thoi Son orchard fruit
summary: Longan, rambutan, xoài cát Hòa Lộc, and mận An Phước, picked from the trees in the Thới Sơn orchards and eaten on the spot.
howToEat: Pick and eat in the garden with a cup of ginger honey tea, or buy fruit to take with you.
where: The orchard stops on cù lao Thới Sơn, about 6 km from Mỹ Tho by boat.
seoDescription: Longan, rambutan, Hòa Lộc mango, and An Phước mận to pick and eat in the Thới Sơn orchards.
